title: {name}: a whole bond life in minutes
lead: One bond day lasts {s} seconds here, so a half-year coupon plays out in six minutes. Same maths and the same steps as a real series.
preview: Preview: the transactions below are examples from a fixture. Nothing is sent to devnet from this page yet.
you: Your {units} bonds earn on this coupon:

detail.pay: 2 to wallets · 1 via the paying agent
detail.record: The hook gate snapshots each position before it moves

now.announced: Coupon 2 is announced. The record date passes by itself and trading never stops.
now.snapshotted: Snapshot complete: 3 holders, Σ 100 bonds = supply. The issuer funds 5,000.00 ₸ before the payment date.
now.funded: The escrow holds 5,000.00 ₸. Anyone can push the payout to the 3 holders.
now.agent: Nomad Pension chose a bank route: 2,762.50 ₸ is with the paying agent until it confirms the bank transfer.
now.complete: Every holder is paid. Anyone can complete the action.
now.done: Coupon 2 paid: 4,512.50 ₸ to 3 holders and 487.50 ₸ to the tax vault.
now.short: The payment date passed and the escrow holds 2,000.00 of 5,000.00 ₸. After the grace day anyone can record a default.
now.defaulted: Coupon 2 is in default: 3,000.00 ₸ short. The bond keeps trading; record-date holders keep their claims.
now.cured: Cured: the escrow is complete. Anyone can push the payout.
now.curedPaid: Paid after the cure: every record-date holder received their coupon.

now.title: What happens now
now.body: This bar names the next step, who may take it and gives you the one button. Switch the role above to see it from each side.

rail.title: The bond's life
rail.body: Every coupon is a stub on the sheet. Paid ones carry their transactions; the ringing one is in progress.

flow.title: Follow the money
flow.body: Bands are proportional to amounts: escrow to each holder, tax to the tax vault, the bank leg through the paying agent. Step through it.

feed.title: Every step is a transaction
feed.body: Each line is one transaction. On a live series the link opens it in the Solana explorer.
